milestones.name: v1.0.0 · Local demo
milestones.description: Deliver a complete synthetic portfolio increment.

milestones.name: v1.1 · Pilot discovery
milestones.description: Resolve cross-domain semantics, grain and disclosure questions.

milestones.name: v1.2 · Managed serving
milestones.description: Prove cloud parity, identity and publication operations before a managed pilot.

issues.title: Compare four products with one metric registry
issues.value: A leader can compare products and trace a shared definition.
acceptance: Four domain dashboards use the same eight KPI definitions.
The overview total matches both the trend sum and regional sum for revenue.
A same-period ratio aggregates numerator and denominator before calculating.
issues.evidence: tests/test_analytics.py and the executive overview walkthrough

issues.title: Make service-delivery data freshness visible
issues.value: Dispatch can distinguish recent operational movement from publication lag.
acceptance: The overview warns on an SLA breach while preserving validated Operations values.
An invalid publication version blocks only the affected domain.
A user can drill to a month and filter a service region.

issues.title: Gate the workforce cohort product
issues.value: Protect the demo release boundary before expanding the workforce product.
acceptance: The feed exposes only region-month aggregates.
A cohort below 20 or an invalid workforce numerator withholds both workforce metrics.
Regional granularity and the accountable owner appear in the dictionary.

issues.title: Triage requests and review the rollout
issues.value: Stakeholders can follow why an item progressed and respond to adoption signals.
acceptance: A request follows the assigned independent decision roles and survives restart.
Two concurrent decisions for one version result in one accepted update.
Early cohort adoption and local feedback are visible and distinct.

issues.title: Assess a bookings-to-revenue bridge
issues.value: Avoid costly month-end confusion while quantifying unmatched orders.
acceptance: Within three working days, identify the minimum shared event keys and compare two allocation rules on synthetic split obligations.
Record unmatched and delayed examples and agree a reconciliation threshold or defer implementation.
issues.evidence: Planned decision record with FP&A and Sales Operations sign-off

issues.title: Assess disclosure risk of workforce drill-down
issues.value: Protect personnel before exposing categories below regional grain.
acceptance: Within three working days, assess overlapping totals, repeated slices and small cohorts on synthetic data.
Record allowable dimensions, release criteria and who approves a real pilot.
issues.evidence: Planned privacy assessment and release decision

issues.title: Agree the missed commitment reason breakdown
issues.value: Dispatch can focus on the most frequent operational causes of missed commitments.
acceptance: Agree a single reason value and explicit unknown rule with all regional leads.
Demonstrate at least 95% source reason coverage on a pilot sample before approving a new slice.

issues.title: Validate serving parity with a Snowflake reader
issues.value: Enable a managed serving backend with equivalent business semantics.
acceptance: Load and validate a dedicated synthetic schema with the supplied Snowflake CLI.
The read-only role matches SQLite totals, trends, quality and drill-down for all eight KPIs.
Record the Snowflake query tag and evidence, then confirm a connection failure yields 503.

issues.title: Design identity and publication operations
issues.value: Make a managed pilot accountable under real identity and dependency changes.
acceptance: Document scope-based permissions, immutable audit retention and responsibility for alerts.
Demonstrate rollback of a bad publication without serving mixed snapshots.
Assign backup, control monitoring and pilot approval owners.
